title: CHVRCHES · The Mother We Share
description: A quiet bedroom and a silhouetted band open into a portrait surrounded by suspended points of light.

performance.lyrics: Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah oh, oh, took your sight. Never cursed your name and keep my lips shut tight. Until you come as far as we're ever going to get until you realize that you should go. oh, oh, oh, oh, in misery Where you can see as old as your omens And the mother we share will never keep Your proud head from falling The way is long but you can make it easy on me And the mother we share will never keep our cold heart from calling in the dying light. I'm the only one here, and I will cover you until you go. oh, oh. If I told the truth, I would always be free and keep a prize with me until you grow oh, oh, oh I'm in misery where you can't seem as old as your romance And the mother we share will never keep your proud head from falling The way it's long but you can make it easy on me And the mother we share will never keep our cold heart from pouring Ah Ah Ah Ah Into the night for once We're the only ones left I bet you even know Where we could go, oh, oh, oh, oh When it all fucks up You put your head in my hands It's a souvenir For when you go, oh, oh, oh From the misery where we can't see as old as your omens And the mother we share will never keep your pride hat from fallin' The way is long, but you can make it easy on me And the mother is sure we'll never keep our cold heart from fallin' Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah
